name: 🫑 Cottage Cheese Dip & Peppers
what: Cottage cheese blended smooth with ranch seasoning, a dip for sweet peppers.

core.name: Ranch seasoning
core.out: ranch dressing, or garlic powder + dill + salt

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter.
Blend 1½ cups cottage cheese, 1 Tbsp ranch seasoning and a squeeze of lemon.
Taste. More ranch if you like.
Halve the peppers and pull out the seeds. Serve around the dip.

key: Blend a full minute. The lumps disappear and nobody can tell.
done: Smooth with no lumps at all.
plan_b: No blender? Use Greek yogurt and just stir.
